vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Elena taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
🛡️ Siobhan, Clarence, Joana and Aidan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Clarence, Aidan are hurt.
Siobhan showed Ivy the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Elena drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Siobhan, Clarence, Ivy and Aki met them at the door — 4 put down. Siobhan, Clarence, Aki are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Wolfgang, Siobhan, Joana, Aidan and Zoe met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Wolfgang, Siobhan, Joana, Zoe are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Mateo strikes the Scarred Chorus Line.
Wolfgang strikes the Scarred Chorus Line.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Chorus Line falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 Wolfgang brought down Scarred Chorus Line. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Wolfgang brought down Scarred Chorus Line. Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Afanasy just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Afanasy and Samia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Samia is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luigi just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Afanasy and Luigi met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Luigi is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Afanasy just put down The Audit... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Samia just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Almaz just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Almaz met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
★ IDENTIFIED (maybe): European Elder. Almaz is sure — "European Elder, see the leaves?" — and you have no reason to doubt them. Yet.
Almaz passes Egusi Melon around the fire — calling it "European Elder" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
